"Blue (Da Ba Dee)" is a song by Italian music group Eiffel 65.
It was first released in October 1998 in Italy by Skooby Records and became internationally successful the following year.
It is the lead single from the group's 1999 debut album, Europop.
Eiffel 65 are an Italian Eurodance group formed in 1997 in the studios of the Turin-based record company Bliss Corporation.
The group consists of Jeffrey Jey, Maurizio Lobina, and formerly Gabry Ponte.
They gained global popularity with their singles "Blue (Da Ba Dee)" and "Move Your Body" from their 1999 debut studio album Europop.
